test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All bottles are plastics.

Some plastics are fibres.

Some fibres are glasses.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some fibres are plastics.

(II) All plastics are bottles.

(III) Some glasses are fibres.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All bottles are plastics.

Some plastics are fibres.

Some fibres are glasses.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1bdb8676b7f796ed406cf20e6d105a34cc01ebd11fa90632e58765666bc9e54.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. Some fibres are plastics - True (Because, Some plastics are fibres).

II. All plastics are bottles - False (Because, All bottles are plastics, But All plastics are bottles can be possible only).

III. Some glasses are fibres - True (Because, Some fibres are glasses).

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
